channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [news] datasette-maplibre 0.1a0
item.description: Datasette-maplibre 0.1a0 is a new geospatial plugin released for Datasette to help users visualize and map data effectively.

item.title: [news] datasette 1.0a43
item.description: Datasette 1.0a43 is a software release that incorporates assistance to progress toward completing its major 1.0 milestone.

item.title: [news] datasette 0.65.6
item.description: Datasette 0.65.6 is a software release that backports a security fix to prevent unauthorized downloads from specific database routes.

item.title: [news] A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
item.description: GPT-6 Astra helped turn a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model into a detailed proof.

item.title: [news] Our new blog for science
item.description: The OpenAI science blog shares new findings, practical methods, and firsthand accounts from researchers using AI to advance scientific discovery.

item.title: [tool] db-branch – database branches in seconds for AI agents and CI, via ZFS
item.description: Db-branch creates instant copy-on-write database branches for MySQL and PostgreSQL using ZFS clones to support AI agents, CI pipelines, and migration testing.

item.title: [news] datasette-apps 0.4a0
item.description: Datasette Apps 0.4a0 introduces sandboxed HTML and JavaScript applications that can run SQL queries directly inside Datasette.

item.title: [news] datasette-agent 0.6a0
item.description: Datasette-agent 0.6a0 is an agent plugin for Datasette that allows users to ask questions directly about their data.

item.title: [repo] vaibhav-space/my-ai-coding-workflow
item.description: Vaibhav-space/my-ai-coding-workflow provides production-grade engineering instructions, curated skills, and a three-stage review pipeline designed to keep AI-assisted software development fast and controlled.

item.title: [paper] Pairing AIS with RF: Analysis of a Markovian Approach for Maritime Data Fusion
item.description: Pair Hidden Markov Model aligns radio frequency detections with AIS trajectories to improve maritime data fusion and vessel tracking.

item.title: [paper] FETTUCCINE: Fast and efficient brain-to-text decoding on mobile devices
item.description: FETTUCCINE is an end-to-end brain-to-text decoding framework that runs efficiently on mobile devices using automatic speech recognition models.

item.title: [paper] Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
item.description: An open-weight reasoning model trained entirely in simulation using reinforcement learning achieves strong performance controlling real robots natively.

item.title: [paper] BAL: Bidirectional Autoregression in Latent Space for Learning Human Movement Representations
item.description: BAL is a self-supervised framework that uses the natural ordering of human movement to predict in a latent space, improving motion captioning, forecasting, and interpolation.

item.title: [paper] WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
item.description: WEIGHTBENCH is a benchmark comprising 42 tasks across five tracks to evaluate large language models on weight-space programming and neural network manipulation.

item.title: [paper] Restoring Diversity in Distilled Image and Video Generators by Probing Activations
item.description: ReDiverse is a method that restores sample diversity in distilled image and video generators by probing internal activations and reintroducing missing variance directions.

item.title: [paper] JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple
item.description: JVT, a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer, enables pixel-space video diffusion without pretrained autoencoders or U-Net skip connections, achieving competitive quality and supporting joint camera-conditioned RGB-disparity generation.

item.title: [paper] Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description: IBMARL is a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that uses imitation policies and centralized critics to accelerate learning and surpass demonstrator performance.

item.title: [paper] Elliptic Sampling: Optimal Interpolant Schedules for Gaussians and Beyond
item.description: Elliptic Sampling is a framework based on complexified ODE trajectories that provides optimal interpolant schedules and a new sampling algorithm called Zoloflow for generative models.

item.title: [paper] Why Finite Intelligence Works in an Infinite World: A Mathematical Theory
item.description: This paper establishes a mathematical theory formalizing future-task information and finite representation bounds to explain how information systems succeed in an infinite world.

item.title: [paper] ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
item.description: ModHarness-RL is a framework that treats reinforcement learning harnesses as learnable and evolving programs to improve model performance across various tasks.

item.title: [paper] Alignment by Socialization: Learning Tradeoffs Under Selection
item.description: This paper studies how evolutionary selection and socialization shape an agent's tradeoffs between completing tasks and following rules of conduct.

item.title: [paper] Understanding Contextual Bias in Agricultural CNNs Through Hidden-Neuron Concept Induction
item.description: This research uses concept induction and quantitative image descriptors to reveal interpretable visual properties associated with hidden-neuron activations in agricultural CNNs.

item.title: [paper] WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators
item.description: WaferTetris is a freeform mapping system for wafer-scale accelerators that flexibly packs computation to improve resource utilization and system throughput.

item.title: [paper] EventSpikeSeg: Memory-Aware Mixed-Signal Architecture for Event-Camera Spiking Segmentation
item.description: EventSpikeSeg is a mixed-signal spiking architecture that uses resident capacitor memory and shared analog processing to perform event-camera segmentation on embedded systems.

item.title: [paper] Box-conditional Hypothesis Testing for Out-of-Distribution Object Detection
item.description: PLUM is a training-free score for out-of-distribution object detection that ranks a box's backbone features against in-distribution classes of the same size and border contact.

item.title: [paper] StreamEmbed: Real-Time Indexing from Pixels for Screenshot Retrieval
item.description: StreamEmbed is an incremental visual embedding system that uses spatial token pruning and temporal KV reuse to enable real-time screenshot indexing and retrieval.

item.title: [paper] Can Mechanistic Interpretability Help Explain LLM Agent Failures? A Case Study on Web Element Hallucination
item.description: This paper investigates why mechanistic interpretability tools struggle to fully explain web element hallucinations in LLM-based agents.

item.title: [paper] MeReader: An Offline, Privacy-Preserving, Progress-Aware AI Assistant for Narrative eBook Reading
item.description: MeReader is an offline, privacy-preserving AI assistant that restricts retrieval and generation to the reader's current progress in a narrative eBook to prevent spoilers.

item.title: [paper] On numerical issues of divergences between nearly equal distributions
item.description: This paper identifies numerical issues in standard categorical divergence operations when distributions are nearly equal, and proposes stable reformulations.

item.title: [paper] Asymptotic Margins and Feature Confinement in Conic Classification Heads under Softmax Cross-Entropy
item.description: This paper demonstrates that conic classification heads trained with softmax cross-entropy feature bounded class regions while maintaining positive asymptotic margins that prevent feature confinement.

item.title: [paper] Agentic induction of common data elements and information extraction from sarcoma case report abstracts
item.description: This paper evaluates an agentic workflow that derives a common data element schema from sarcoma abstracts and extracts clinical data at scale.

item.title: [paper] Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
item.description: Agentic AI framework uses a large language model and circuit verifier to synthesize fault-tolerant quantum error-correcting circuits through evolutionary program synthesis.

item.title: [paper] ARCHER: From Rationale Imitation to Executable Reasoning in Small Language Models
item.description: ARCHER is a two-stage training framework that teaches small language models to solve mathematical problems using executable action traces and calculator grounding.

item.title: [paper] TradeGauntlet: Evaluating Compliance Controls for Autonomous Trading Agents
item.description: TradeGauntlet is a replayable limit-order-book simulator that evaluates compliance controls for autonomous trading agents by separating detection, prevention, and execution costs.

item.title: [paper] Interactive Program Induction with Language Model Priors
item.description: Interactive Program Induction with Language Model Priors introduces a greedy query-selection algorithm that uses a language model as a prior to recover target programs from few input-output examples.

item.title: [paper] From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
item.description: Agentic robotics is proposed as a future direction for supervised systems in remote patient monitoring, connecting AI agents and robots with clinicians and patients through auditable workflows.

item.title: [paper] MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
item.description: MMFlash improves multimodal speculative decoding by adaptively upweighting visually dependent tokens and using sparse attention for long video, yielding up to 3.58× lossless speedup.

item.title: [paper] Bregman geometry in regular exponential families: dual representations and relative smoothness
item.description: Bregman geometry in regular exponential families establishes dual Bregman representations and normalization results, providing geometric characterizations of parameter spaces and relative smoothness.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Feedback-Driven Black-Box Processes via Stochastic Modeling and Simulation
item.description: A stochastic framework models and evaluates feedback-driven black-box processes using Markov chains and simulation to provide sound estimators and performance measures for fuzzers.

item.title: [paper] Do Verifier Judgments Survive Abstraction? Measuring Verification Transport for LLM Agent Evaluation
item.description: Verification Transport is a reliability test measuring whether LLM-based verifier judgments remain stable when execution observability changes due to abstraction-induced boundaries.

item.title: [paper] Contrastive latent representation learning with denoising score matching
item.description: ScoreCLR is a contrastive representation learning method that estimates repulsive force using denoising score matching with a lightweight network trained jointly with the encoder.

item.title: [paper] Score-based neural ordinary differential equations for reaction-diffusions
item.description: Score-based neural ordinary differential equations develop a Lagrangian method for reaction-diffusion equations by combining characteristic ODEs with a learned velocity field and weighted particle training.

item.title: [paper] Node Localization by Multidimensional Scaling with Iterative Majorization
item.description: Node localization algorithms use multidimensional scaling based on iterative majorization to estimate node positions from diverse data sources and characteristics.

item.title: [paper] Typing Matters: Muscle, Language and Typing Behaviour in Live Keystroke Decoding from sEMG
item.description: A fully causal sEMG typing decoder built on a state space model fuses a traditional decoder with an autoregressive language model to decode live keystrokes from muscle signals.

item.title: [paper] Sample-efficient prediction of high-entropy alloy strength through outcome-aware robust sequential learning
item.description: Robust Outcome-aware Sequential Experimentation for High-Entropy Alloys proposes a sample-efficient framework for predicting ultimate tensile strength from alloy composition and processing conditions.

item.title: [paper] Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
item.description: Callo is a disaggregated serving system that leverages invalidated key-value states for speculative decoding drafts to reduce agent session latency.

item.title: [paper] When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
item.description: Support-Gated World-Model decision support uses a recurrent dynamics ensemble and a behavior model to predict short-horizon physiological responses while withholding low-support predictions.

item.title: [paper] Mesh-Free Weak-Form Regression for Learning Interaction Kernels from Particle Trajectories
item.description: Mesh-free weak-form regression uses smooth test functions and empirical particle averages to learn interaction kernels from noisy particle trajectories without requiring density reconstruction.

item.title: [paper] Dynamic bigraphical Matérn--Whittle processes: learning dependence graphs among spatial-temporal fields
item.description: Dynamic bigraphical Matérn-Whittle processes model spatial-temporal fields and their time-varying dependencies across variables using exact posterior estimation over graph eigenmodes.

item.title: [paper] Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
item.description: A two-level ensemble method uses stochastic decoding and semantic prompt perturbations to decompose large language model uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components using black-box sampling.

item.title: [paper] PACT: A Decoder-Confidence-Guided Two-Round Receiver for Joint Channel and Phase-Noise Estimation in Sub-THz OFDM
item.description: A decoder-confidence-guided two-round receiver combines a complex transformer estimator, equalization, and neural decoding to jointly estimate frequency-domain channels and phase noise in sub-THz OFDM.

item.title: [paper] Between Obligations and Evidence: A Participatory Study of Translating the EU AI Act into Technical Requirements
item.description: A participatory workshop study investigates how researchers, policymakers, and practitioners interpret EU AI Act obligations and translate them into measurable technical requirements.

item.title: [paper] Toward On-Device Markerless 6DoF Tracking of a Physical Manipulative on a Mixed-Reality Headset: A Preliminary Study
item.description: An on-device markerless six-degree-of-freedom tracker uses a compact YOLO model and a perspective-n-point solver to align virtual overlays with a physical manipulative on a standalone mixed-reality headset.

item.title: [paper] Towards Explainable Sleep Stage Classification using Single-Channel Electroencephalogram
item.description: A study evaluating explainable AI methods for single-channel electroencephalogram sleep staging finds that Integrated Gradients consistently achieves the highest mean attribution fidelity across datasets.

item.title: [paper] Do Underwater Image Quality Metrics Agree with Human Perception? A Benchmark with Human Choices, Simple Edits and Generative Drift
item.description: TrustUIQA is a benchmark that evaluates 73 underwater image quality metrics against human preferences, revealing that no metric consistently matches human judgments.

item.title: [paper] The State Is Not the Bottleneck: A Paged-State Gated-DeltaNet Tile on a Tri-Mode Multicast Mesh, Bit-Exact from RTL to Silicon
item.description: A hardware tile for edge FPGAs computes complete layers of a Gated DeltaNet model while paging recurrent state, demonstrating that weight delivery limits performance rather than state size.

item.title: [paper] Graph diffusion transformer for interpretable generation and inverse design of disordered atomic structures
item.description: Graph Amorphous Diffusion Transformer is a generative model that enables interpretable generation and inverse design of disordered atomic structures while accelerating sampling speed.

item.title: [paper] LECAT: Measuring LLM Category Learning from Pretraining Data
item.description: LeCat is a two-part evaluation and analysis framework that measures how large language models acquire category knowledge and traces how pretraining data influences this learning process.

item.title: [paper] CoPre-MoE: Consolidating and Preserving MoE for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
item.description: CoPre-MoE is a shared-and-private mixture-of-experts framework that eliminates parameter redundancy and prevents catastrophic forgetting during multimodal continual instruction tuning.

item.title: [paper] LitArc-Bench: Disentangling Text-Specific Reader-Response Dynamics from Position and Lexical Affect
item.description: LitArc-Bench is a Chinese-language evaluation benchmark that separates text-specific reader-response dynamics from position and lexical affect to measure how well models track human emotional trajectories.

item.title: [paper] Fuse-PINN: Combining Finite Element Methods and Physics-Informed Neural Networks to enable massively parallel simulations of non-linear PDEs
item.description: Fuse-PINN is a mathematically robust Finite-Element-Method framework for Neural Networks that enables massively parallel simulations of non-linear PDEs on GPU-based high-performance computing systems.

item.title: [paper] Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
item.description: Gamer is a generalist agent framework that integrates perception, memory, and multi-step reasoning, trained through continued pre-training, sparse-thinking instruction tuning, and multi-turn reinforcement learning to interact efficiently in 2D and 3D environments.

item.title: [paper] Deep Neural Networks Training Efficiency: Does Grokking Modify its Dynamics?
item.description: An analysis of deep neural network training dynamics finds that grokking, or the delayed emergence of generalization, does not materially alter overall training-efficiency dynamics measured by accuracy per unit energy.

item.title: [paper] Smart Home Agents Make Capable but Unpredictable Grid Operators
item.description: An outage simulation study evaluates smart home agents acting as grid operators during power outages, identifying new failure categories and limitations in current models.

item.title: [paper] Lipschitz-Constrained Discriminators in Generative Modeling: Asymptotic Behavior and Support Mismatch
item.description: A study characterizes the asymptotic behavior of optimal discriminators associated with Lipschitz-regularized KL-divergences, motivating improved training strategies for generative models with discrete empirical measures.

item.title: [paper] WeatherDreamer: Learning a World Model from Multimodal Earth Observations
item.description: WeatherDreamer is a world model that learns an end-to-end recursive filtering cycle from multiple global observing systems to forecast weather and infer unobserved variables without traditional data assimilation.

item.title: [paper] VelServe: Taming Decode Jitters in LLM Inference with Tail-Calibrated Scheduling
item.description: VelServe is a tail-calibrated scheduler for large language model inference that uses iteration latency measurements to prevent decode jitters and meet latency service-level objectives.

item.title: [paper] A systematic comparison of physics-informed neural networks and mechanistic models for epidemic modeling and forecasting
item.description: A systematic comparison between physics-informed neural networks and a stochastic mechanistic model shows that physics-informed neural networks achieve better performance on real COVID-19 data while traditional compartmental models remain valuable.

item.title: [paper] Where Tree Ensembles Decide: Structural Local Explanation with Decision Predicate Graphs
item.description: Local Decision Predicate Graphs gather executed decision rules into a verifiable record to explain tree ensemble predictions by identifying critical feature thresholds.

item.title: [paper] Structure makes quantum circuits trainable
item.description: An analytical framework and sampling algorithm bound the gradient variance of quantum circuits to determine whether a given variational quantum algorithm is trainable before expensive training begins.

item.title: [paper] AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
item.description: A two-stage AI-based framework combines unpaired GAN-diffusion models and masked video reconstruction to synthesize realistic, temporally consistent multi-view echocardiographic sequences from dynamic heart meshes.

item.title: [paper] Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
item.description: A comprehensive survey reviews 88 works on vision-language-action models, categorizing their life cycle across design, training, and deployment for robotic manipulation, navigation, and humanoid control.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Human Sensitivity to Gender Biased AI-Generated Content through Human Assessment of Google's Autocomplete Function
item.description: An empirical study evaluating Spanish-speaking participants shows that attributing statements to AI does not alter reaction times or agreement judgments regarding gender-related content.

item.title: [paper] f-Divergence Self-Play for Tabular Anomaly Detection via Large Language Models
item.description: DiSPaT is a self-play fine-tuning framework that uses f-divergence minimization and synthetic pseudo-anomalies to improve large language model performance on tabular anomaly detection.

item.title: [paper] DECODE: Decomposable Environments for COntrolled Sequential-Decision Evaluation
item.description: DECODE is a benchmark comprising partially observed consumer-credit environments that allows controlled experimentation to evaluate the impact of specific modifications on sequential decision solvers.

item.title: [paper] Adaptable Watermarking: Transforming Image Watermarking Models via Lightweight Adapters
item.description: Lightweight adaptation framework that transforms neural image watermarking models into modular architectures, enabling multi-style support without full model retraining.

item.title: [paper] Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
item.description: Agentic robotics, centered on an Embodied System 2 formed by a foundation model and embodied harness, requires a shared evaluation framework and research roadmap to achieve reliable physical autonomy.

item.title: [paper] Online Switching Control as Learning with Experts
item.description: Adaptive switching algorithm that minimizes cumulative cost in nonlinear systems by reducing online switching control to the experts problem.

item.title: [paper] MaskSCD: Bitemporal Mask Classification for Semantic Change Detection in Remote Sensing Images
item.description: MaskSCD is a bitemporal mask classification transformer model that performs semantic change detection in remote sensing images while maintaining consistent change and semantic maps.

item.title: [paper] VLAN: Vision-Language Accessible Navigation
item.description: Vision-Language Accessible Navigation is a benchmark containing diverse scenes, trajectories, and embodiment-specific accessibility labels to evaluate physical safety and user-constraint alignment.

item.title: [paper] DIRT: Depth-completed Image-based Rendering using Two-band Blending for Live Novel-view Synthesis
item.description: DIRT is a non-neural, optimization-free image-based rendering approach that uses depth completion and two-band blending for live novel-view synthesis across heterogeneous sensors.

item.title: [paper] Emulating physics-based XCO2 retrievals across OCO-2 viewing modes with compact neural networks
item.description: Compact multilayer perceptron models that efficiently emulate full-physics carbon dioxide retrievals from satellite spectra across multiple viewing modes and years.

item.title: [paper] Marimba: A System One Model for Speech
item.description: Marimba is a speech interface built on frozen audio features to perform typed conversational tasks such as turn detection, speaker counting, and language identification.

item.title: [paper] Unlocking Cross-Attention in Label-Scarce Regimes: A Weakly Supervised Approach for Video Semantic Segmentation
item.description: MemCAM is a transformer framework for weakly supervised video semantic segmentation that stabilizes temporal cross-attention learning through feature-space self-supervision.

item.title: [paper] Causal AI-Driven Secure mmWave Beam Alignment with Defensive Variational Autoencoders
item.description: Causally-aware deep learning framework integrating causal discovery and defensive variational autoencoders to achieve efficient and secure millimeter-wave beam alignment.

item.title: [paper] Learning Word-Level Explanations of Text Reuse in Latin Literature with Little Annotation
item.description: Active learning procedure and pointer network architecture that explain text reuse in Latin literature word by word using minimal manual annotations.

item.title: [paper] Experts Across Schemas: Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Relational-Experts for Cross-Database Generalization
item.description: MoREGT is a mixture-of-relational-experts graph transformer combined with an LLM agent that improves cross-database predictive modeling using significantly less pretraining data.

item.title: [paper] AI for Parameter Selection in Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
item.description: Machine-learned models predict quantum simulation errors and runtimes from Hamiltonians and candidate configurations to select optimal parameters for sample-based quantum diagonalization.

item.title: [paper] When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI
item.description: Clinical AI judges that grade other systems can become part of the intervention when used to select prompts or train models.

item.title: [paper] PrivacyPR: A Dataset of Real-World Privacy Fixes for Benchmarking Privacy-Aware Code Review
item.description: PrivacyPR is a dataset of real-world privacy fixes and GitHub pull requests that serves as a benchmark for evaluating privacy-aware code review in coding agents.

item.title: [paper] Clean Tickets, Wrong Orders: Catching Silent Errors with a Language Model in Your Browser Tab
item.description: A fine-tuned language model running entirely within a web browser tab parses and scores typed food orders to detect silent errors without sending text off the device.

item.title: [paper] GT-FENG: General Theory of Factual Evaluation and Normative Grounding in Language Models *Author(s)
item.description: GT-FENG is a general evaluation framework and open-source Python package that checks language model answers against applicable rules across rule-governed domains like law and policy.

item.title: [paper] Right Token, Right Time: From Per-Token Gating to Trajectory-Aware Activation Steering
item.description: Contrastive Feature Projection and Closed-Loop Adaptive Bernoulli Steering are budgeted gating methods that steer large language model behavior while preserving generation quality.

item.title: [paper] From Bytes to Behavior: Request-Level Attribution from Live GPU Hidden States
item.description: A non-modifying debugger method acquires per-layer residual-stream activations from a live GPU process to examine the operational behavior of deployed language models.

item.title: [paper] TetraCoder: Adaptive Tetrahedral Encoding for Neural Fields
item.description: TetraCoder is a hash-free adaptive tetrahedral encoding that links an explicit tetrahedral spatial encoder with an implicit signed distance field for 3D reconstruction and editing.

item.title: [paper] MamaReason: Unfinished Reasoning and Answer Recovery in Clinical Language Models
item.description: MamaReason studies clinical language model behavior where answer continuation returns diagnoses already stated in unfinished clinical reasoning traces.

item.title: [paper] Structural Self-Teaching for Compositional Generation in Unified Multimodal Models
item.description: Structural Self-Teaching is a framework that enhances compositional image generation in diffusion-based unified multimodal models by converting internal phrase grounding into training-time structural signals.

item.title: [paper] NER-D: A cross-domain benchmark for German NER
item.description: NER-D is a cross-domain benchmark for German named entity recognition comprising 13 datasets across 9 domains, used to evaluate proprietary and open-source models under various training settings.

item.title: [paper] Deep Bundle Adjustment
item.description: Deep Bundle Adjustment is a graph neural network that amortizes bundle adjustment to recover camera poses, intrinsics, and scene structure from 2D matches across multiple views.

item.title: [paper] Pose-based Neural Clothing for Animated Characters
item.description: Traditional garment simulation for animated characters is a time-consuming bottleneck for artists due to slow simulations and tedious parameter tunings.Recent data-driven methods offer a powerful alternative, capable of learning from a dataset of simulated data to generate…

item.title: [paper] ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
item.description: ParetoM3 is a single-loop first-order algorithm that solves a penalty-based min-max-min formulation to compute stationary solutions for preference-guided multi-objective optimization problems.

item.title: [paper] Lens: Training-Free Semantic Search for Cross-Tile Object and Scene Retrieval in Satellite Imagery
item.description: Lens is a training-free semantic search system that uses frozen vision transformer features and spatial debiasing to enable real-time cross-tile object and scene retrieval in satellite imagery.

item.title: [repo] AcgBoss/manus--ai
item.description: AcgBoss/manus--ai is a general-purpose autonomous AI agent system that runs code and controls a web browser within a sandbox environment to automate multi-step tasks.

item.title: [repo] SandyPandyMandy/manus--ai
item.description: SandyPandyMandy/manus--ai is a general-purpose autonomous AI agent system that runs code and controls a web browser within a sandbox environment to automate multi-step tasks.

item.title: [repo] XTwiNSaraX/ai--manus
item.description: XTwiNSaraX/ai--manus is a general-purpose autonomous AI agent system that runs code and controls a web browser within a sandbox environment to automate multi-step tasks.

item.title: [paper] Dancing Tokens on the Vocabulary Network from LLM Generation
item.description: A similarity network built from large language model input embeddings maps generation onto pre-trained geometry to reveal that consecutive generated tokens rarely act as graph neighbors.

item.title: [paper] Probabilities of Causation in Nondeterministic Causal Models
item.description: Researchers derive sharp analytic bounds on probabilities of causation under various assumptions tailored to nondeterministic causal models using a generic identification program.

item.title: [paper] RACE: Ranking-Uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
item.description: RACE is a framework for efficient sequential recommendation that dynamically adapts model capacity and input sequence length based on a list-wise ranking-uncertainty metric.

item.title: [paper] D2ToF: One-Step Diffusion for Depth Super-Resolution from Lightweight Single-Photon LiDAR Waveforms
item.description: D2ToF is a one-step diffusion framework that uses distilled diffusion and multimodal guidance to perform depth super-resolution on low-resolution single-photon LiDAR waveforms.

item.title: [paper] SCAR: Bridging Coarse Retrieval and Fine Localization through Candidate Reranking
item.description: SCAR is a spatial consistency-aware reranking method that improves natural-language point-cloud localization by selecting the most accurate coordinate hypothesis from a candidate pool.

item.title: [paper] Neural Classifiers as Error-Correcting Codes
item.description: A proposed framework characterizes supervised deep classification as the decoding of error-correcting codes, explaining the geometry of neural representations and improving model quantization and distillation.

item.title: [paper] Small Is Not Dead: Distance-Aware Cluster Revival for e-means
item.description: A distance-aware cluster revival method for the e-means algorithm prevents the removal of small, isolated clusters by evaluating inter-centre distances relative to mean squared error.

item.title: [paper] NeoResearch: Literature- and Experience-Guided Autonomous Time Series Model Discovery
item.description: NeoResearch is an autonomous research framework that uses large language models to mine scientific literature and conduct iterative experiments for discovering lightweight, domain-specific forecasting models.

item.title: [paper] Personalization of Basic and Moral Values Guiding LLM-Controlled Assistant Robots
item.description: A study evaluating human value personalization for personal assistant robots finds that contemporary large language models do not automatically adopt desired user values through default behavior or prompt engineering.

item.title: [paper] From Pen-and-Paper to Machine-Checked Proofs: Lean for System Identification
item.description: This paper introduces the Lean 4 proof assistant for system identification and control, demonstrating how to formalize mathematical proofs and check them with software.

item.title: [paper] T2ST: Data-Efficient Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models via Temporal Data and Knowledge Transfer
item.description: T2ST is a data-efficient training framework that enhances spatio-temporal foundation models by augmenting sparse spatio-temporal observations with auxiliary time series and knowledge transfer.

item.title: [paper] MarathonTS: a benchmark of long synthetic time series from window assembly and long-series generators
item.description: MarathonTS is an open benchmark for comparing long synthetic time series generation methods across fidelity, utility, memorization, and computational cost.

item.title: [paper] SemRAG: Semantic-Guided Sentence-Level Retrieval-Augmented Sign Language Production
item.description: SemRAG is a semantic-guided retrieval-augmented sign language production framework that retrieves full-sentence signing templates to generate sign pose sequences while suppressing irrelevant motions.

item.title: [paper] LaMe: a Joint Latent Mediation Framework for High-Dimensional Systems
item.description: LaMe is a joint linear-Gaussian framework that summarizes high-dimensional exposure-mediator-outcome systems using a small number of latent variables to improve mediation analysis.

item.title: [paper] Explanations that Transfer: Interpreting Medical Retrieval with Sparse AutoEncoders
item.description: Method that applies Sparse Autoencoders to medical information retrieval to transform dense text embeddings into semantically interpretable representations that improve retrieval relevance and out-of-domain transferability.

item.title: [paper] STaG: Human-Annotation-Free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Text-Based Person Retrieval
item.description: Framework named STaG that uses Style-Agnostic Text Alignment and Heterogeneous Graph Memory Alignment to perform human-annotation-free unsupervised domain adaptation for text-based person retrieval.

item.title: [paper] ALoMa: Affine Correspondences Beyond Patches
item.description: Affine correspondence estimator named ALoMa that uses LoMa keypoint descriptions to jointly learn the full 4-DoF matrix at the image and image-pair levels, improving downstream tasks.

item.title: [paper] Who Counts as Exposed? Measurement Choices in an Open, Re-estimable Index of Occupational AI Exposure
item.description: Open task-level occupational AI exposure index that varies context and calibration design choices across reasoning models to evaluate their impact on workforce exposure measurements.

item.title: [paper] Detection and Classification in Latent Spaces: High-Dimensional Analysis and Validation
item.description: Statistical framework for analyzing high-dimensional latent representations of foundation models to predict false-alarm and miss-detection error probabilities for binary and multi-class classification tasks.

item.title: [paper] On the Limits of Sufficient Explanations
item.description: Formal analysis characterizing the conditions under which sufficient explanations exist for classifiers on structured data such as graphs and strings.

item.title: [paper] A Multi-Layered AI Pipeline for BPMN Generation from Natural Language
item.description: Multi-layered pipeline that integrates transformer models, large language models, and ontology population to automatically transform unstructured natural language descriptions into BPMN process diagrams.

item.title: [paper] Who Should Be on the Panel? Task-Conditioned Persona Selection for LLM Trading Agents
item.description: Multi-agent trading system named FinPanel that uses task-conditioned persona selection to recruit a tailored panel of trader personas for each stock based on a statistical sketch of its trading style.

item.title: [paper] Which Model, For Which Variable? Per-Variable Forecast Combination in Sparse ICU Time Series
item.description: Per-variable forecast combination method that combines predictions from multiple models fitted specifically for each variable to improve forecasting accuracy on sparse multivariate ICU time series data.

item.title: [paper] Compiling Specialized GPU-Initiated Networking
item.description: Compiler named Obaleth that integrates GPU-initiated communication into intermediate representation to co-optimize it with computation and lower it to specialized transport code for faster distributed machine learning.

item.title: [paper] STAMP: Manufacturing-Informed Generative Design and Shape Optimization of Sheet Panels
item.description: Generative design method called STAMP embeds manufacturing conditions directly into shape representations to produce valid sheet metal panels without undercuts or thickness violations.

item.title: [paper] DRA-HTR: Disentangling Representation and Adaptation for Handwritten Text Recognition
item.description: Unsupervised generative domain adaptation framework called DRA-HTR adapts handwritten text recognition models to target visual characteristics and integrates language models for post-correction.

item.title: [paper] When Copying Is Hard to Beat: A Negative Result in Clinical Assessment Forecasting
item.description: Study on clinical assessment forecasting shows that standard models achieve no consistent advantage over simple persistence-based baselines when predicting daily ICU questionnaire items.

item.title: [paper] Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
item.description: Large language model-empowered agent called fast-charging control uses reinforcement learning to adaptively manage lithium-ion battery charging while balancing time, degradation, and safety constraints.

item.title: [paper] PUMA-Former: Uncertainty-Aware Agentic Computation Offloading in MEO-LEO Satellite Networks With Incomplete Information
item.description: Uncertainty-aware agentic framework called PUMA-Former manages workload offloading in MEO-LEO satellite networks to improve task completion rates and reduce service delays.

item.title: [paper] JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
item.description: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to finance, creating a need for benchmarks that evaluate their capabilities across financial systems with different regulations and practices.

item.title: [paper] PRISM: A Post-Prediction Reliability Framework for Evidence-Guided Correction and Selective Abstention
item.description: Post-prediction reliability framework called PRISM evaluates model outputs, retrieves historical evidence, and applies corrections or abstains when predictions are unreliable.

item.title: [paper] Efficient Poincaré Convolutions through Patch-Statistics Factorization
item.description: Factorized Poincaré convolution layer accelerates hyperbolic neural network training updates by computing patch statistics directly without constructing explicit ball-valued patches.

item.title: [paper] Muon Attains $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ Iteration Complexity under Shuffling
item.description: Stochastic optimizer Muon achieves an O(epsilon^-3) iteration complexity for smooth nonconvex finite-sum problems under shuffling strategies.

item.title: [paper] Optimizing Drilling Trajectories in Multi-Material Structures Using Quantum Annealers
item.description: Quantum-hybrid optimization approach models drilling trajectories as constrained routing problems to minimize energy consumption and tool-wear penalties in multi-material structures.

item.title: [paper] Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models
item.description: Interpretable weight-space programming method uses large language model agents to build transparent transformers and neural encoding models by programming weights in code without backpropagation.

item.title: [paper] Folding Language Models into Themselves
item.description: Concertina is a knowledge distillation method that builds a compact language model directly from a teacher model's weights to recover most of its capabilities efficiently.

item.title: [paper] An In-Silico Audit of Topographic Organization in a Multimodal Brain-Response Model
item.description: An in-silico audit of the TRIBE v2 multimodal brain-response model reveals that it lacks classic retinotopic and tonotopic organization while retaining strong motion selectivity.

item.title: [paper] Contagious Fingerprints: When LLMs Inherit Another Model's Identity
item.description: Contagious Fingerprints introduces Lineup, a method that accurately detects model substitution in LLM conversations by generating reference replies on the same dialogue history.

item.title: [paper] KnowVis: Dual-View Evaluation and Diagnosis of World-Knowledge Grounding in Text-to-Image Models
item.description: KnowVis is a dual-view evaluation and diagnosis framework that uncovers gaps in world-knowledge grounding for text-to-image models using hierarchical taxonomies and a multimodal judge protocol.

item.title: [paper] EcoVGGT: Pinned-Key Inference for Efficient and Streamable Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Long Videos
item.description: EcoVGGT is a training-free inference framework that uses pinned key frames to enable efficient, streamable, and long-video 3D reconstruction with feed-forward multi-view transformers.

item.title: [paper] Do Machines Learn Deviance From Their Peers? A Randomized Test of Differential Association With AI Agents
item.description: A randomized experiment using AI agents demonstrates that peer communication significantly influences whether agents adopt deviant or honest behaviors during coding tasks.

item.title: [paper] AG-JEPA: Anatomically Guided Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Neurodegenerative Representation Learning
item.description: AG-JEPA is an anatomically guided joint embedding predictive architecture that improves brain MRI representation learning for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis and progression prediction.

item.title: [paper] VEPO: Mitigating Multilingual Hallucinations in LVLMs via Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization
item.description: VEPO is a training-time preference optimization method that reduces object hallucinations in low-resource languages by transferring visual grounding from English using evidence-guided masking.

item.title: [paper] Training-point consistency of kernel ridge regression with varying correlation scales
item.description: This paper establishes a unified theoretical framework for the consistency of training-point risk in kernel ridge regression under varying correlation scale parameters.

item.title: [paper] Deep Latents, Long Memory: Latent persistence explains temporal correlations in transformer activations
item.description: Research demonstrates that deeper layers in large language models encode latent features with longer persistence times, which explains the growth of temporal correlations in their activations.
